description: Team Bubbles — representing the Roxbury Community College (RCC) Computer Science Club out of Boston! Bringing full RCC team spirit to the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge to turn real Martian ISRU engineering trade-offs into hands-on STEM fun. Cowabunga!
summary: An interactive JPL Mission Control simulator for ages 7–12 where players tele-operate a robotic Mars outpost across a 14-minute light-speed delay to synthesize rocket propellant using real NASA MOXIE/Sabatier engineering trade-offs.
